title: Fractal Hyper-Trees: Combinatorial Enumeration, Symmetry Properties, and Ultrametric Structures
summary: This paper introduces and formalizes Fractal Hyper-Trees (FHT), a novel class of hypergraphs characterized by deep recursive inclusion hierarchies and controlled relational textures. Moving beyond classical graph-theoretic frameworks, we establish an axiomatic foundation for FHTs and investigate their combinatorial enumeration, revealing explicit connections to OEIS sequence A398931.
